# Typography Rules

- Font family and fallback stack: TBD
- Base size and modular ratio: TBD
- Semantic roles: display, heading, body, label, caption, code.
- Define font weight, size, line-height and letter-spacing per role.
- Prefer unitless line-height or explicitly tested responsive values.
- Constrain reading measure with a responsive maximum width.
- Test long Indonesian words, mixed Indonesian/English, numbers, currency, dates and URLs.
- Verify font glyph coverage, font loading, fallback rendering and layout shift.
- Verify 200% zoom and contrast in the rendered theme.
- Do not blindly transform punctuation in code, identifiers or technical content.
